The '''Hall of Perri-Teeka''' was a building constructed in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the capital city of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Located near to the [[Plasma Refinery Complex]], the hall was dedicated as a monument to the famed statesman [[Perri-Teeka/Legends|Perri-Teeka]].
